values: Reusable manual-admin auction workbook for roster order, item starts, priority insertion, auction list generation, and finalize-to-history.

For L&D/T&S: priority members are allocated first every generated auction using their priority limit, then normal rotation continues for non-priority members only. If the current normal cycle fills and quantity remains, the next normal cycle starts at the first non-priority roster row.
Card ignores priority but respects Card Cycle: rotate from the start member, fill members below 1/1 first, then reset only if cards remain after everyone is full.
Illu Fragments are free-for-all page-count slots and do not affect member cycle counts.
Adjust Roster row order manually before an auction. Enter Auction Setup quantities/start members. In Google Sheets, use Auction Tools > Generate Auction List.
Roster is the main view: cycle counts are editable current-cycle values capped at each member limit, while current live slots come from Auction List.
Use Auction Tools > Cancel Auction to clear the generated Auction List and live Roster slots without changing History or cycle counts.
After bids are correct, use Auction Tools > Finalize Auction to append final members to History, refresh Roster, and clear Auction List.
After importing this .xlsx into Google Sheets, open Extensions > Apps Script, paste the code from the Apps Script tab, save, and reload the sheet.
Optional: add Google Sheets drawings/buttons and assign scripts named generateAuctionList and finalizeAuction.
